name: Soldier
descriptionLines: &7A swiss knife of a kit - everything you need to fight, survive and win in the same place

name: Cryo
descriptionLines: &7Provides an ability to freeze areas and slowing down the opponents, while having good area control

name: Smoke
descriptionLines: &7Excellent utility to block enemies line of sight and deny area with special gas grenades

name: Breach
descriptionLines: &7Good utility to remove obstacles, breach walls and initiate fights

name: Spy
descriptionLines: &7Provides utility for flanking and stealth attacks

name: Recon
descriptionLines: &7Utility helps locate enemies and initiate a fight with them

name: Juggernaut
descriptionLines: &c&lWarning: &fThis kit already provides a main weapon
&7Haha minigun go brrr

name: Rush
descriptionLines: &7Utility gives a lot of movement-based buffs to help rush into the fight

name: Stealth
descriptionLines: &7Provides an ability to turn invisible and flank enemy lines

name: Nano
descriptionLines: &7Utility helps to blind enemies and relocate with ender pearls

name: Jetpack
descriptionLines: &7Provides you a jetpack which you can use in many different ways

name: Grapple
descriptionLines: &7The grappling hook gives many opportunities to relocate, flank or get into good angles

name: Demoman
descriptionLines: &7For the next three hundred years, people who needed to get to the second
&7floor used the only method available to them: shooting a rocket
&7launcher at their feet. Yes, it was ridiculous, crippling,
&7and awful, but what are you going to do? Not go to the
&7second floor? That's where your bed is.

name: Blade
descriptionLines: &c&lWarning: &fThis kit already provides a main weapon
&7You are really fast and do a lot of melee damage, but lack in protection

name: Enforcer
descriptionLines: &c&lWarning: &fThis kit already provides a main weapon
&7You get a bullet-blocking shield and a powerful two-short sword

name: Pyro
descriptionLines: &7Kit provides a fire thrower and other fire-based utility

name: Explosive
descriptionLines: &7Kit provides a powerful homing rocket launcher and explosive utility

name: Toxic
descriptionLines: &7Utility helps to control and lock down areas with powerful gas grenades

name: Biohazard
descriptionLines: &7Kit provides a biogun and some chemical utility

name: Chainsaw
descriptionLines: &7Makima fanboy kit

name: Sniper
descriptionLines: &c&lWarning: &fThis kit already provides a main weapon
&7Kit provides the infamous NTW-20 as the main weapon,
&7which can one-shot anyone, but you are easier to kill

name: Medic
descriptionLines: &7Provides utility to heal and support your allies

name: Bulldozer
descriptionLines: &7Kit allows to modify the map and build on with with its utility

name: Tech
descriptionLines: &7Provides utility to lock down area with traps and view it from cameras

name: Engineer
descriptionLines: &7Kit provides a bunch of turrets which can be placed and will shoot any foes

name: Missile
descriptionLines: &7Kit provides powerful missiles which you can point and launch

name: Artillery
descriptionLines: &7Provides a lot of different airstrikes to use on your enemies

name: Nuclear
descriptionLines: &7The name speaks for itself

name: Hostage
descriptionLines: &7A kit used for the hostage in the 'Hostage Rescue' gamemode
